shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log({version:p.version,dependencies:p.dependencies,devDependencies:p.devDependencies?.ajv})\" && npm ls ajv --depth=0 || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "ls node_modules/ajv/dist | sed -n '1,80p'; cat node_modules/ajv/package.json | sed -n '1,100p'; cat tsconfig.json; cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'; sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml; rg \"specs/.*#|spec:\" src -g '*.test.ts' | head -40"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg \"specs/.+#[0-9]+\" src scripts -g '*.ts' | head -60; sed -n '1,220p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; sed -n '1,220p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs; git log -3 --oneline --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"interface ToolDefinition|type ToolDefinition|inputSchema\" src/types/ai.ts node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts node_modules/ajv/dist/types/index.d.ts | head -30; sed -n '1,90p' src/types/ai.ts; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/ajv/dist/types/index.d.ts; git show HEAD"'^:src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '"'1,140p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md && npm run spec:names:fix -- specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "Validate tool input before execution" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
